_comment: The cached listing snapshot per GBP connection, exactly the metadata the 6h sync cron writes. tools.mjs recomputes score from items (an item with unknown: true is renormalized OUT of the denominator, as lib/listings/score.ts does) and stale from fetched_at against the frozen NOW (26h line). Item keys, labels, weights and hints are the route's own.

items.label: Business name
items.hint: Exact real-world business name - no keyword stuffing.

items.label: Address
items.hint: A complete storefront address anchors local rankings.

items.label: Phone number
items.hint: Primary phone - must match the number on your website (NAP consistency).

items.label: Website link
items.hint: Drives clicks and lets Google associate your site with the listing.

items.label: Primary category
items.hint: The single strongest local ranking factor.

items.label: Additional categories
items.hint: Cover every service you actually offer.

items.label: Business hours
items.hint: Listings without hours lose "open now" searches entirely.

items.label: Business description
items.hint: A 750-character description with your services and area.

items.label: Service area / storefront set
items.hint: Tell Google where you serve.

items.label: Attributes
items.hint: Accessibility, amenities, payments - filters customers actually use.
